reference.title: Toward an internally consistent pressure scale
reference.source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

recalculation.notes: Official Table S1 supplies temperature plus row-wise Au volume and uncertainty for every observation, and gold_fei_2007_vinet_2 is executable. Direct re-reduction is ready but differs from the printed pressures by 0.701 GPa RMS (mean +0.669 GPa); no undocumented correction is inferred.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: The complete source table is bundled. Limiting ferropericlase spin branches reproduce the published V0 values and printed errors; exact thermal parity remains conditional because the source does not state row flags, weights, temperature-error treatment, or covariance scaling.

fit.objective: orthogonal distance regression using printed pressure and volume sigmas; temperature held fixed
fit.solver_message: dedicated Ricolleau et al. (2009) audit completed

locations: Supporting Information readme and Table S1
primary_source_check.finding: One independent thermal BM2 fit for KLB-1 Mg-perovskite.

source_locations: Official Supporting Information readme and Table S1
primary_data_check.finding: All 153 Mg-perovskite P-V-T observations are bundled with their printed one-sigma pressure and phase-volume uncertainties: 17 rows at 300 K and 136 heated rows. The raw source table also preserves Au and pressure-medium volumes.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experimental Procedure; Section 3; Table 1; Supporting Information readme and Table S1.
parameter_provenance.equation: Section 3: high-temperature Birch-Murnaghan with K0'=4 fixed, represented by BM2 plus AlphaKT.
parameter_provenance.thermal_law: Table 1 alpha0, alpha1 and dK/dT with alpha(T)=alpha0+alpha1*T.

selection.qualification: The paper does not publish row exclusions; this audit selection is not asserted to be the authors' undocumented exact selection.

fit_provenance.objective: Orthogonal distance regression with printed one-sigma P and Mg-perovskite volume uncertainties; temperatures held fixed.
fit_provenance.covariance_scaling: Unscaled ODR covariance from printed observation sigmas; the paper's convention is unreported.

reproduction.qualification: The paper does not state its weighting, temperature-error treatment, or covariance scaling.
